description: Execution profiles for one W4 model. Settings cover weight residency, caching, kernel selection, and measurement. Numerical changes require their own identity and quality evidence.

recipe_lock.note: H3 PDD sampling belongs to the model recipe. A different step count or CFG requires a new recipe identity and quality evidence.

knob_parameters.dit_block_cache_bytes_note: A 24 GiB LRU leaves room for activations and the system within the 28.08 GiB recommendation. It covers about 64% of the 37.47 GB DiT package.

q4_kernel_impl.mpsgraph: Production MPSGraph dequantization and matmul with FP32 dequantization.
q4_kernel_impl.steel: MIT-licensed MLX Steel affine QMM port using FP16 MMA with FP32 accumulation.
q4_kernel_impl.simd: Onyx SIMD kernel derived from the Steel layout, with transposed weight staging and branch-free accumulation. Historical isolated results were 4.99 ms versus 5.27 ms for Steel at 1024×5376×5376.
q4_kernel_impl.nax: MLX affine QMM running on the M5 neural accelerators through Metal Performance Primitives, with BF16 scales and affine biases. On GPUs without neural accelerators the engine falls back to the MPSGraph path.

knob_notes.text_weights: The 21.86 GB W4 text encoder requires streaming on the reference target.
knob_notes.dit_weights: The 37.47 GB W4 DiT package streams one block at a time.
knob_notes.vae_weights: The FP32 VAE is 2.34 GB. Resident mode caches tensors and streaming mode loads and releases weights by tile.
knob_notes.vae_tiling: Existing overlap equivalence evidence covers tile16. A new geometry requires independent validation.
knob_notes.dit_block_cache: Reuse original DiT weight bytes across the six sampling steps. The cache must preserve output bytes. Measure its benefit with an interleaved matrix.
knob_notes.weight_prefetch: Stream the next block's weights while the GPU computes the current one. Streaming only: one extra block in memory and the output bytes do not change.
knob_notes.q4_kernel: The nax kernel changes the numeric path against mpsgraph: 46% of the outputs of every layer differ by one BF16 ulp. Against FP64 reference products both paths sit 2-5 half-ulps of the typical output from the exact value, and neither is uniformly closer.

max-quality.title: Max quality
max-quality.summary: The default verified W4A16 path with FP32 exceptions, FP32 VAE, and all six PDD evaluations.

gates.peak_process_note: Use process-tree physical footprint with an RSS fallback, as in RunRecord. The 28.08 GiB limit comes from Metal on the reference machine.

max-quality.future: Treat streamed W8 or BF16 weights as separate derived model identities with independent quality gates.

memory-min.title: Minimum memory
memory-min.summary: Stream text and DiT weights by block and load VAE weights per tile to reduce peak residency.

gates.peak_process_note: The provisional 2 GiB limit comes from the November 17 measurements at 1.79–2.00 GiB. Use physical footprint with an RSS fallback.
gates.bitwise_note: Weights and decoding are identical to max-quality. Changing residency must preserve the output bytes.

m5-fast.title: M5 fast path
m5-fast.summary: The max-quality settings with Q4 linear layers on the M5 neural accelerators. On GPUs without them, the engine falls back to the MPSGraph kernel.

numeric_equal_to.note: The nax kernel rounds scales and biases to BF16 and sums each product in another order, so the PNG differs from max-quality. Compare the final images and report the differences. See docs/PROFILES.md.

speed-focus.title: Speed experiment
speed-focus.summary: Evaluate a BF16 SIMD kernel and DiT cache with resident VAE weights. Interleave cold and warm measurements within their respective groups.

must_be_fastest_within.note: Use interleaved medians. Report results within observed dispersion as inconclusive when the margin is missed.

numeric_equal_to.note: The Steel FP16 runtime probe at m=69 had maximum error 0.00028 on real weights. The declared absolute tolerance is 0.05. See docs/PROFILES.md.
